verdict.rationale: Riskified has maintained Shopify (docs-11, 21, 22, 33), Salesforce Commerce/SFCC (docs-10), and Magento (docs-34) integrations, plus automated chargeback gateway integrations for major PSPs (Braintree, Stripe, Adyen, PayPal - docs-4, 17). However, BigCommerce is not mentioned anywhere in the evidence pack, and integration depth for named platforms varies (Shopify is well documented, SFCC/Magento less so). missing for 10: BigCommerce integration, broader PSP list beyond the four named, evidence of ongoing maintenance/version support for these integrations.
